reviews.text: They refused to send me any photos. I didn't know if my dog ​​was dead or alive.
I highly recommend them! Excellent service, thank you so much, my dogs are happy.
A dog boarding kennel like few others! A family who takes excellent care of our little dogs and a magnificent setting for their stay. I highly recommend it!

We had an appointment between 1 p.m. and 2 p.m. (the appointment was in writing, so there was no room for error). We arrived as planned, a little before 2 p.m. (I gave him 30 minutes' notice, as he had requested). Upon arrival, I called him several times, but there was no answer. There was no doorbell. We were pressed for time because we had a plane to catch. My boyfriend went in through the gate to let him know we were coming (by knocking on his door). His dog barked, waking him up. He threw his shoe at the dog, insulting it and yelling at us through the patio doors, calling us an intrusion. I found him very aggressive. In the meantime, I had contacted another boarding kennel that had a space available, thankfully, since he had already told us there was no point in coming back. It wasn't a very pleasant experience.

+ responsiveness, approximately 12 m² for a kennel
- They tell you the dog went out 3 times a day, but during the 48 hours her tracker was working, the GPS track indicates she stayed in her kennel. My dog ​​arrived home so dehydrated that she barely urinated for the next 24 hours despite being given a huge amount of water as soon as she came in. She coughed whenever she walked (she had been vaccinated against kennel cough since May; the vet diagnosed it as the flu, €85).
In short: since it's certain the person in charge lied about "3 long walks a day," it raises doubts about hygiene, heating, everything. I reported all of this to the DDPP (Departmental Directorate for the Protection of Populations) using my real name (Julie is a pseudonym) because my dog ​​was only there for 3 days, but a dog is permanently boarded there. If you have to leave your dog there and it needs walks, I recommend asking for photos with timestamps. In my case, it ensured my dog ​​went for a walk on the last day.
My dog ​​Juna (8-day boarding) was treated like a princess with several walks a day and plenty of water to keep her cool in the heat. The enclosure includes a small house and a small yard. …
Our little dog Milli stayed at Keepdog, where she was pampered and spoiled for two weeks. I wholeheartedly recommend them and would entrust her to them again without hesitation.

Following an emergency hospitalization, I had to find a boarding facility to place my two furry friends as quickly as possible, and KeepDog went above and beyond to find a solution and secure a spot for them! They stayed for a total of 10 …
I called about a life-threatening emergency during the week for the weekend, and I received no answer, despite writing a lengthy explanation of the situation. …

Excellent!!! 100% recommended!
I left my dog ​​Laila with them during the Christmas holidays and almost the entire month! …
